manifest.name: Storage
manifest.description: Keeps track of the storage the server can use.

errors.local_folder_not_allowed: A folder can only be added when Music Assistant does not run in a container. Map the folder into the container as a volume instead.
errors.folder_path_not_absolute: Enter the full path of the folder, starting with a /.
errors.folder_is_root: The root folder of the server can not be added.
errors.folder_is_server_folder: The data and cache folders of Music Assistant can not be added.
errors.folder_already_location: This folder already is a storage location.
errors.folder_unreadable: The folder {0} can not be read right now.
errors.folder_not_mounted: The drive or share of this folder is not mounted.
errors.storage_not_responding: The storage of this location does not respond. Check that the drive is connected, or that the server of the network share is online.
errors.folder_not_registered: This folder was not added as a storage location.
errors.location_in_use: The music source {0} uses this folder. Disable or remove that music source first.
errors.path_not_allowed: This folder is not inside a storage location you can use.
errors.not_a_folder_source: This music source does not read its files from a folder of this server.
errors.no_mount_backend: This installation of Music Assistant can not mount network shares. Mount the share on the host and make it available to Music Assistant instead, see {0}
errors.mount_not_permitted: This installation of Music Assistant is not allowed to mount network shares. Mount the share on the host and make it available to Music Assistant instead, see {0}
errors.mount_backend_unavailable: This network share can not be mounted right now: what mounted it is not available.
errors.share_type_not_supported: Network shares of type {0} can not be mounted here.
errors.share_version_not_supported: Protocol version {0} can not be used here for this type of network share.
errors.share_name_invalid: Enter the name of the share without slashes or commas.
errors.share_username_invalid: A user name can not contain a comma.
errors.share_password_missing: Enter the password of the user, or leave the user empty to connect as a guest.
errors.share_changed: This network share was changed in Home Assistant, so Music Assistant leaves it alone. Change it back or remove it in Home Assistant.
errors.supervisor_mounts_unavailable: Home Assistant does not mount network shares for Music Assistant right now. Try again later, and update the Music Assistant app when this keeps happening.
errors.export_path_invalid: Enter the full path of the export, starting with a /.
errors.share_already_added: This network share already is a storage location.
errors.mount_folder_unsafe: Music Assistant does not mount network shares on {0}: another user of this server could have prepared that folder. Remove it, and try again.
errors.share_mounted_already: This network share is mounted already, and available as the storage location {0}.
errors.share_not_found: There is no network share named {0}.
errors.share_not_mounted: The network share did not become available. Check that its server is online and try again.
errors.share_unavailable: The network share is not available right now.
errors.share_no_answer: The server of the network share did not answer in time. Check that it is online and try again.
